subject: 🎟️ You're Invited — $event_name on $event_date
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

You're invited! Details for the event below — please RSVP so we can plan numbers, catering, and accessibility.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EVENT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Event:           $event_name
Type:            $event_type
Date:            $event_date
Time:            $start_time – $end_time
Location:        $location
Host:            $host_name
Dress Code:      $dress_code
Cost:            $cost
Capacity:        $capacity
RSVP By:         $rsvp_by
RSVP Link:       $rsvp_url
Event ID:        $event_id

About the event:
$event_description

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IF YOU NEED SOMETHING SPECIFIC

  • Dietary requirements, BSL interpretation, step-free access, or quiet-room access can be arranged — please mention these when you RSVP.
  • Plus-ones are $plus_ones_policy.
  • Programme handouts will be available on arrival and on the event page after the event.

We hope you can make it.

Kind regards,
$host_name
